title: Magnet Scene 5 stays frozen: clip on a MASK layer loses its instanceName + onClipEvent (HasClipDepth PlaceObject2 omits Name/ClipActions) — ballmask load never fires, _root.ballmask undefined
description:
RESOLVED (compiler fix). Root cause confirmed exactly as filed: the mask-layer
PlaceObject2 emit path set ONLY HasClipDepth (0x46) and dropped HasName(0x20) +
HasClipActions(0x80) for a named, scripted MovieClip used as a mask.

FIX (packages/swf):
- shapes.ts encodePlaceObject2WithClipDepth() now takes optional instanceName +
  clipActions and emits flags = 0x46 | HasName(0x20)? | HasClipActions(0x80)?,
  with SWF/Ruffle field order Matrix, [Name], [ClipDepth], [ClipActions]
  (verified vs ruffle/swf/src/read.rs read_place_object_2_or_3: name before
  clipDepth, clipActions last). Extracted a shared writeClipActionsBlock() so
  the three clip-action emitters (WithClipActions / MoveWithClipActions /
  WithClipDepth) share one byte layout.
- compiler/frames.ts (scene timeline): moved the loopMode/effectiveClipActions/
  instanceName computation ABOVE the clipDepth branch (they were mutually
  exclusive — clipDepth `continue`d before name+clipActions were computed). The
  symbol-instance mask branch now passes displayObj.instanceName + the effective
  (authored + loopMode-synthesized) clipActions through. Shape/DrawingObject mask
  path left byte-identical (model carries no name/clipActions).
- sprite.ts (symbol-internal mask): same fix — passes instName + effectiveClipActions
  alongside clipDepth.

VERIFY:
- pnpm --filter './packages/**' build: green.
- @flash/swf: 118 files / 1472 tests pass (incl. self-determinism, masklayer,
  placeobject2, clipactions, sprite-clipactions, magnet-charids). Added
  packages/swf/src/__tests__/mask-named-clip-1349.test.ts (4 tests): mask PO2
  carries HasName+HasClipDepth+HasClipActions together; name bytes present;
  onLoad event flag present; nameless/scriptless mask still emits ONLY HasClipDepth.
- @flash/core: 5518 pass; 2 fail in 3 files, all ENOENT on fixtures/flash8-empty.fla
  (absent in BOTH main checkout and worktree) — pre-existing fixture-missing
  failures (task-1207 class), NOT a regression from this change.
- RUFFLE E2E (acceptance): apps/desktop/e2e/mask-named-clip-1349.spec.ts — publishes
  a faithful Scene-5 repro (named MovieClip "ballmask" with onClipEvent(load) on a
  mask layer above a masked child), runs it in the bundled Ruffle via traceObserver:
  PASS (1 passed, 8.2s). The load handler FIRES and traces "MASK1349 name=ballmask
  root=movieclip" — proving both (a) onClipEvent(load) runs and (b) _root.ballmask
  resolves. Existing mask-layer.spec.ts + nested-movieclip-playback.spec.ts: 4 passed
  (no rendering regression). (Ruffle bundle symlinked from main checkout per CLAUDE.md;
  symlink removed before commit.)
